summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by PRF Technologies Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting FDA clearance of an IND application for OcuRing-K, a sustained-release ocular drug-delivery device. The filing announces a regulatory milestone allowing a Phase II clinical trial for post-cataract pain and inflammation. No special-situation transaction (merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, etc.) is involved. The press release describes the company's clinical development progress but does not constitute a corporate event requiring special-situations classification. The filing is a routine current report of material regulatory progress.
